findingClass: a pm2 process runs without TZ in its environment, exposing new Date() parsing to the box's local time
failThreshold: any IN-SCOPE pm2 process's env lacks a TZ key
scope: IPODhan's own pm2 processes only: process name starts with 'ipodhan-', plus 'notifier' — narrowed from all pm2 processes by owner decision 2026-09-29 (closes #1115's scope question), since the shared VPS also runs other apps' processes (firekaro-api) and infra modules (pm2-logrotate) that are not ours to fix and whose missing TZ was noise burying a real IPODhan/notifier miss
unverifiableWhen: pm2 not reachable on the host running the audit (expected off the production box)
